source_groups.label: Original Chapter LXXX heading, scope, printed circular horoscope

Chap. LXXX. If Presbytery shall stand?
The author asks whether Presbytery will continue.

figure_timestamp

Old Style dual-year notation and historic time conventions retained; no recasting.
scope
Judgment upon the Figure above said
Lilly offers an interpretation of the particular figure rather than a universal observation of all ecclesiastical systems.
Specific English Commonwealth and contemporary clergy setting.
